title: 13th Annual 2026 Hot Rod Holiday
seo_title: 13th Annual Hot Rod Holiday Car Show in Springfield, MO
description: Hot Rod Holiday is an indoor car show in the 75,000 square foot E-Plex buildings, featuring street rods, custom cars, street machines, hot pickups, race cars and imports from across the Midwest. There is also a model car contest, a pin up contest, automotive artists and vendors. It takes place November 21 and 22, 2026 at the Ozark Empire Fairgrounds in Springfield, MO, with the November 21 time to be determined.
address: Fairgrounds Arena, Springfield, MO 65803, United States, Springfield, MO
